entries.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Manifest Tentacles from the Depths. If you have at least 5 Feeding stacks, they're consumed to apply Frenzied Feast, increasing Crit Damage and the damage of Tentacle Slam by 100%, and causing Nightmare Gaze to apply an additional stack of Madness. Lasts 5 seconds and stacks to 2. If you don't have Frenzied Feast, applies Bottom Feeder, doubling the number of Feeding stacks you gain and reducing Crit Damage by 200% for 3 seconds.
notes: Pet cannot be summoned if a pet is already equipped.
Pet cannot be summoned during combat.
